issue.title: Google upstreams: large requests fail with "http2: client connection lost" on a slow uplink (health-check ping kills a live upload)
issue.body:
## Summary

On a slow uplink, every large request to a Google upstream (Antigravity, Google Vertex, Google AI Studio) fails with `http2: client connection lost` after 35–55 s, while the request body is still uploading. The connection is slow but alive. The error string comes from Go's HTTP/2 health check (`closeForLostPing`, counted as `conn_close_lost_ping`; both strings are in the magpie binary). It looks like the read-idle ping times out because the PING/ACK sits behind queued request-body DATA, so magpie closes a working connection.

Small requests on the same uplink, at the same time, succeed.

## Environment

- magpie 0.1.1698, macOS (Darwin 27.0)
- Agent: Pi 1.4.0 via magpie's OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- Group `gemini-4-argon` (routing `order`): `antigravity/gemini-4-argon` (2 accounts), `google-vertex/gemini-4-argon`, `google/models/gemini-4-argon`
- Uplink during the failures: about 2–10 KB/s measured to Cloudflare, Anthropic and Google (a remote-desktop stream was using most of it). Downlink was fine.

## Reproduction

Two fresh Pi sessions, no tools, started at the same moment:

```
pi -p --no-session --no-tools --model magpie/group/gemini-4-argon @small.md "Reply with only: OK"   # 4.4k tokens
pi -p --no-session --no-tools --model magpie/group/gemini-4-argon @big.md   "Reply with only: OK"   # 175k tokens (~680 KB)
```

From magpie's routing log (`net` timings in seconds):

| Request | Try | Status | send | wait | reused conn | Error |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4.4k tokens | antigravity | 200 | 0.2 | 14.2 | yes | |
| 175k tokens | antigravity | 502 | 44.5 | 0 | no | http2: client connection lost |
| | antigravity (2nd account) | 502 | 36.6 | 0 | no | http2: client connection lost |
| | google-vertex | 502 | 35.6 | 0 | no | http2: client connection lost |
| | google | 502 | 37.8 | 0 | no | http2: client connection lost |
| | antigravity | 502 | 39.1 | 0 | no | http2: client connection lost |
| | antigravity (2nd account) | 502 | 36.3 | 0 | no | http2: client connection lost |
| | google-vertex | 502 | 38.7 | 0 | no | http2: client connection lost |
| | google | 499 | – | – | no | the agent canceled the request |

Every failed try opened a new connection (dns/connect/tls all present), so this isn't a stale pooled connection. `send` never finished, and `wait` never started.

The same thing happened three times in a real Pi session that evening (~170k-token prompts, 8 tries per request), until Pi cancelled after about 5 minutes. In the same session, an hour earlier, a 177k-token request on a fresh connection uploaded in 1.4 s and succeeded, so prompt size alone isn't the problem; size combined with a slow uplink is.

## Likely cause

Go's `http2.Transport` with `ReadIdleTimeout` set sends a PING after that much read inactivity and closes the connection if no ACK arrives within `PingTimeout`. While a large body is uploading, the server sends nothing, so the read-idle timer fires. On a saturated uplink the PING is queued behind body DATA in the socket send buffer, so the ACK can't come back within `PingTimeout`. The connection is declared lost even though bytes are still moving.

The steady 35–45 s failure point fits a read-idle timeout plus a ping timeout.

## Impact

- Large-context sessions on Gemini upstreams can't continue at all while the uplink is slow. Small requests and other upstreams keep working, which makes this look like a model or extension bug.
- Failover makes things worse: the same body is uploaded again to every group member, twice, so a request burns about 5 minutes and several uploads of ~700 KB before the agent gives up.

## Suggestions

1. Don't treat read-idle as dead while the request body is still being written: skip or extend the health-check ping until the body is fully sent, or use a longer `PingTimeout` for upstream connections.
2. Classify "lost ping during upload" as a client-side network failure, and don't fail over to other members with the same body (they share the same uplink), or at least don't retry the whole group twice.
3. Optionally expose the timeout as a provider option, like `patience=`.
4. Report the cause to the agent plainly ("upload stalled: local uplink too slow for a N KB request") instead of a generic 502 or 499.

comments.body:
The cause is magpie's HTTP/2 health check, not the uplink: every vendor request goes through a transport whose HTTP/2 config pings a connection that has had no frame for 20s and drops it when no answer comes within 10s (`netproxy.HTTP2Health`, used in `internal/gateway/upstream_transport.go`) — added for #2843. Go starts that timer on the last frame *received* and does not consider what is being written. A large body uploads for tens of seconds while the vendor sends little, and the ping is written behind that body's own DATA in the same ordered stream, so its answer cannot come back before the body's last byte. The health check therefore closed a connection that was moving bytes the whole time, which is why small requests on the same uplink were fine.

The branch sends a request whose body is or may still be under way (a stated length of 64KB or more, or none stated) through a transport that does not run that read-idle ping. That connection is instead ended when a write puts no bytes on it for a minute (`WriteByteTimeout`), and the 10-minute wait for the vendor's first byte still ends a vendor that never answers. Small requests keep the pinged transport, so #2843's silent connection is still found and dropped in about 30s (its tests, `TestSilentHTTP2ConnectionIsDropped` and `TestGroupMovesOnFromSilentHTTP2Connection`, pass unchanged). A body under 64KB on an uplink slower than about 3KB/s can still outlast the ping window; that is the size to widen if it shows up.

Branch: [fix/3909-google-upstreams-large-requests-fail](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3909-google-upstreams-large-requests-fail), commit 8eaf63866f76a88b2ddb096e9bcc99295ebb7ed0.

Run at that commit: `TestUploadStillUnderwayIsNotCutByHealthPing` (new) sends a 262212-byte chat body over a path paced to 64KB/s, against a vendor pinged after 200ms and dropped 300ms later. Without the change it fails in 0.56s with `Post "https://…": http2: client connection lost` while the vendor's handler sees `client disconnected`; with it the vendor reads all 262212 bytes over HTTP/2. Also run: `gofmt -l` (nothing), `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/gateway/`, the new test under `-race`, and the #2843 tests. The full `go test ./internal/gateway/ ./internal/netproxy/` was started but not finished here (that package takes 10-50 minutes on this machine), so no result is claimed for it.

This is a fork branch, ready to review; it makes no claim on the issue.

v0.1.1845 修了这个问题（05ed578bd）。感谢 @yxd-ym 的报告，也感谢 @skygunner 查出原因并给了分支（8eaf63866），这次的改动是在它的基础上做的。

**原因**：magpie 为了 #2843（连接静默断开导致请求一直挂着），会给 HTTP/2 连接发 ping：20 秒没收到帧就发一次，10 秒内没回应就断开。但上行慢的时候，ping 排在请求体的 DATA 后面，要等最后一个字节到了 Google 才能回，所以一个正在上传的连接被当成断线关掉了。

**改法**：skygunner 的分支让所有 64KB 以上的请求都不做 ping，但那样大请求就失去了 #2843 的保护：静默断开的连接会把整个请求体收进内核缓冲区，然后一直等 10 分钟。现在的改法是：
- 默认所有请求仍然做 ping；
- 大请求（≥64KB 或长度未知）如果因为 ping 丢失而失败，就在一条新的、不做 ping 的连接上重发一次。这条连接一分钟写不出字节才放弃；
- 之后 30 分钟内的大请求直接走这条连接，所以慢网络下每半小时最多浪费一次请求，不会每轮都浪费。

**实测**（真实 Antigravity 账号，gemini-3.8-flash-low，约 298KB 的请求，本地代理把上行限到 8KB/s）：
| | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 修复前的版本 | 182 秒后失败：`http2: client connection lost`，与报告一致 |
| 修复后，第一个大请求 | 第一次尝试在 ping 丢失时失败，重发后成功（80–106 秒） |
| 修复后，之后的大请求 | 直接走不做 ping 的连接，成功（46–80 秒） |
| 不限速对照 | 3 次全部成功（14–34 秒） |

还有一个没查清的现象：限速下修复后的 7 个大请求里，有 2 个上传完了，但 Google 在 300–400 秒内没有回应；同一条连接上的下一个请求正常返回。不限速时没出现过。这两个请求遇到时会等到 10 分钟的响应超时，分组会切到下一个成员，不会像之前那样每次都失败。如果你那边升级后还碰到很久没有回应的情况，请在这里说一下。

这个 issue 先开着，等你在自己的网络上确认。

Patch: https://github.com/JoeyWu-tech/magpie/tree/fix/3909-cut-try, commit 5ade5056 on origin/main a5315c70 (applies as is on e1721d64), `git format-patch --no-signature --full-index --stdout a5315c70..5ade5056 | sha256sum` is `a2ba5d013f9f7843e8647be12221acad9f8c010a28d99f5737bc99f62029f10a`.

TestUploadStillUnderwayIsNotCutByHealthPing is red on ubuntu CI in every main Test run since 05ed578b that wasn't cancelled (eight so far, so ubuntu's Race step hasn't run since either), 5 of 5 on my Linux box, and 3 of 3 on WSL in #4033; macOS CI passes it. It's the test, not the change: it came unchanged from skygunner's 8eaf6386, where no try was ever cut, so its vendor takes a failed read as an error. With 05ed578b the first try is cut by the lost ping on purpose, and the try sent again on the unpinged connection is read whole (262,212 bytes) and answered. The cut try's read fails only when the test's cleanup closes the fake uplink, and that t.Errorf is what marks the test red. TestSlowUplinkSkipsTheLostTry counts the same cut try and ignores its failed read; this handler now returns on it, and the reply check still needs the whole body. Taking the retry out, or letting the retry be pinged too, turns it red again. Test-only.

44e1fec3 made the same change a minute after I posted this, so mine isn't needed. The one bit it doesn't have: the doc comment above the test still ends "A body that may still be under way is not watched by that ping", while since 05ed578b the first try is watched, and is cut.

issue.title: Linux box (wsl-run): 7 internal/agent install-detection tests and TestTreeRSS red at main

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Seen while mote (the macOS test box) was unreachable, so a change's suite ran on the Linux box instead (`wsl-run`, WSL2 distro magpie-desktop, Go 1.26.8). Each of these is red at origin/main eb6d1d8d9 run alone on that box too (`go test -tags nogui -count=1 -run …`), so they are the box or Linux under WSL, not a change. None is about the change that ran.

internal/agent (a fake binary the test writes under /tmp doesn't run, or isn't found):
- TestInstalledVersion: `cliupdate_test.go:60: "0.98.2": ""`
- TestHowInstalled: `cliupdate_test.go:192: pnpm: <nil>` (passed alone once)
- TestGrokInstalled: `grok --version fails: /tmp/TestGrokInstalled…/.grok/bin/grok: Invalid argument`
- TestCursorFolderFromTheEditorIsNotTheCLI: `the cursor-agent command on PATH no longer finds Cursor CLI`
- TestCopilotFolderFromAnIDEPluginIsNotTheCLI: `the copilot command on PATH no longer finds the Copilot CLI` (passed alone once)
- TestOmpDetectedWithPiDir: `omp's command is not`
- TestZedAppPath: `CLI's bundle: "/tmp/TestZedAppPath…/Applications/Zed Preview.app", <nil>`

internal/proc:
- TestTreeRSS: `rss_test.go:32: a running sleep holds 0 bytes (false)`

(internal/gateway's TestUploadStillUnderwayIsNotCutByHealthPing is red there too, 3 of 3 at main; that one is #3909.)

"Invalid argument" on exec suggests the distro's /tmp can't run what a test writes there (#3141's same-tick proc.Look may be the rest). If the box is meant to run the whole suite, these need a cause; if not, wsl-run's doc should say which packages it can't.

issue.title: [Feature Request] Claude 订阅：历史图片每轮都重传上游，按账号走 Files API 只传一次

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 结论

Claude 订阅经 Claude Code 应答时，会话历史里的每张图，每一轮都随请求重新上传给 Anthropic，上行字节随图片数线性增长。建议在订阅桥里按账号把每张图上传到 Files API 一次，交给 Claude Code 的图片块改成 `source.type: "file"`。

#1820 管的是客户端到 magpie 这一段，并且说了“按上游缓存它自己的 file id 留到以后”。这里是 magpie 到上游的那一段：在慢上行链路上，真正耗时的就是这段。这件事不减少视觉 token，只减少上行字节和每轮等待。

## 现在的行为

环境：magpie 0.1.2190、Claude Code 2.1.312、macOS。

Pi 经 `/v1/chat/completions` 请求 `claude/claude-haiku-5-5`：第 1 轮带一张图，之后几轮只有文字。用 nettop 按进程看 `claude` 的 bytes_out：

| 第 1 轮的图 | Claude Code 会话里存成 | 之后每轮 claude 进程的上行 |
|---|---|---|
| 1206×2622 PNG 截图，约 544 KB | JPEG，base64 181,008 字符（约 136 KB） | 约 116 KB |
| 1024×1024 随机噪声 PNG，约 3.1 MB | JPEG，base64 672,560 字符（约 504 KB） | 约 514 KB |
| 无图对照 | — | 不到 20 KB |

所以历史里有 N 张截图，每轮就多传约 N × 120 KB。几十张截图就是每轮数 MB；在 #3909 那样 2–10 KB/s 的上行上，一轮要等几分钟。直连 Anthropic 时有人测过：84 张截图的会话约 11 MB/轮。

客户端自己绕不开：

- Chat 里的 `{type: "file", file_id}` 到订阅桥会被渲染成 `attachmentText` 的文字占位，模型看不到图。
- 上传必须用这一轮实际选中的账号的凭据和组织。客户端既没有这份凭据，也不知道路由选了哪个账号。

## 已验证的一点

Claude Code 2.1.312 在 `-p --input-format stream-json` 下，会把 `{"type":"image","source":{"type":"file","file_id":"…"}}` 原样带给 API：

- 给一个不存在的 file_id，这一轮失败，表现和 API 返回 404 一致（Claude Code 把它报成 “There's an issue with the selected model”）。
- 同一请求去掉这个图片块，正常返回。

所以订阅桥只需要换掉交给 Claude Code 的图片块，不用改 Claude Code。还没用真实 file_id 完整跑通一轮。

## 建议做法

1. 拉起或续接 Claude Code 之前，按内容哈希查这一轮所用账号的映射；没有就用该账号的 OAuth 令牌 `POST /v1/files` 上传一次，记下 file_id。映射按组织记（`anthropic-organization-id` 响应头）：换号或交接到另一个账号时，按新账号重传一次，不复用别的组织的 id。
2. 同一会话里同一张图始终用同一个 file_id，请求前缀逐字节不变，提示缓存照常命中。
3. 上游报 `` File `file_…` not found ``（文件被删或过期）时，作废这条映射，重传后重试这一轮，只重试一次。
4. 上传失败时这一轮照旧内嵌，不中断对话。
5. 会话被清扫时删掉它上传的文件，或上传时带 `expires_in_seconds`。

先例：[pi-firecode 的 claude-files.ts](https://github.com/Suge8/firecode/blob/main/provider/claude-files.ts) 给 Pi 直连 Anthropic 做的就是这件事：按内容哈希记、按组织记映射、遇到 file not found 作废重传，并且有 OAuth 凭据的分支。

## 未确认

- 用订阅 OAuth 令牌调用 Files API 在使用条款上的边界。
- 改成 file 引用后，Claude Code 不会再把 PNG 转成 JPEG；上传前要不要按同样的规则缩小，由你定。
- `--resume` 续接时，Claude Code 会话文件里存的是 file 引用还是图片字节，未验证。

相关：#1820、#3909、#4239

issue.title: [Bug] Antigravity (daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com) 经本地代理调用时频繁在 21 秒处触发 502 unexpected EOF（空闲连接复用与 SendPingTimeout=20s 冲突）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### 问题描述 (Description)

在使用 Magpie 调用 Antigravity（`daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`，模型如 `gemini-4-argon`，开启 `high` 推理强度）并经由本地代理（Clash / Mihomo `127.0.0.1:7890`，SS / IEPL 专线）转发时，**只要两轮对话间隔在约 50~90 秒之间，下一轮请求极易在第 1 次尝试等待约 21 秒后稳定报错 `502 unexpected EOF`**，随后等待 1 秒自动发起第 2 次重试（新建 TCP 连接）才能成功。

虽然 Magpie 的自动重试保证了请求最终不丢失，但每次触发都会导致首包前平白多卡顿 **~22 秒**；此外在长耗时生成中途也偶发 `Antigravity: connection lost mid-reply (unexpected EOF)`。

### 报错截图与界面表现


界面报错信息：
- `user@example.com (gemini-4-argon) 以 high 推理强度 返回 502 · 失败，且无其他可问；这可能是暂时性错误，1.0 秒 后重试一次，此时尚未向 DeepSeek Harness 发送任何回复。`
- **时间花在哪里**：`magpie 内耗时 44 毫秒` · `发送请求 257 毫秒` · `读取回复 21 秒`
- **原话**：`Post "https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse": unexpected EOF`

---

### 日志证据与规律分析 (`usage.jsonl` + 代理内核日志)

统计本地 `~/.config/magpie/usage.jsonl` 中同一时段的多笔 `tries: 2` 记录，发现首次失败+重试等待耗时（`retried_ms`）高度恒定在 **`21,499 ms ~ 21,899 ms`**：

```json
{"agent":"dsh","provider":"antigravity","model":"gemini-4-argon","in":2049,"out":144,"cache_read":277698,"ms":32963,"ttft_ms":32854,"sent_ms":22862,"own_ms":282,"retried_ms":21597,"status":200,"tries":2}
{"agent":"dsh","provider":"antigravity","model":"gemini-4-argon","in":2049,"out":192,"cache_read":278663,"effort":"high","ms":44473,"ttft_ms":44368,"sent_ms":22967,"own_ms":162,"retried_ms":21499,"status":200,"tries":2}
{"agent":"dsh","provider":"antigravity","model":"gemini-4-argon","in":2049,"out":369,"cache_read":117467,"effort":"high","ms":34125,"ttft_ms":33522,"sent_ms":22372,"own_ms":107,"retried_ms":21499,"status":200,"tries":2}
{"agent":"dsh","provider":"antigravity","model":"gemini-4-argon","in":2049,"out":2124,"cache_read":195213,"effort":"high","ms":62245,"ttft_ms":44410,"sent_ms":22657,"own_ms":330,"retried_ms":21573,"status":200,"tries":2}
{"agent":"dsh","provider":"antigravity","model":"gemini-4-argon","in":2049,"out":165,"cache_read":322364,"effort":"high","ms":45735,"ttft_ms":45631,"sent_ms":24406,"own_ms":266,"retried_ms":21848,"status":200,"tries":2}
{"agent":"dsh","provider":"antigravity","model":"gemini-4-argon","in":2049,"out":1224,"cache_read":360050,"effort":"high","ms":43684,"ttft_ms":36054,"sent_ms":24457,"own_ms":374,"retried_ms":21899,"status":200,"tries":2}
```

将上述记录与本地 Mihomo (Clash) 的 `[TCP]` 建连日志逐笔对齐后发现 **100% 一致的规律**：
1. **第 1 次尝试 (`t = 0.0s`) 均未新建 TCP 连接**：全部复用了连接池中建连已达 `84s ~ 285s`（空闲超过 `50s ~ 60s`）的旧 HTTP/2 连接。
2. **第 1 次尝试恒定在 `~20.5s` 处报 `unexpected EOF`**：对应 `internal/netproxy.Install` 中配置的：
   ```go
   HTTP2: &http.HTTP2Config{
       SendPingTimeout: 20 * time.Second,
       PingTimeout:     10 * time.Second,
   }
   ```
   数学关系完全吻合：`20,000ms (SendPingTimeout) + ~250ms (发送请求) + ~250ms (PING 触发远端断连 RTT) + 1,000ms (重试等待) ≈ 21,500ms (retried_ms: 21499)`。
3. **第 2 次重试 (`t ≈ +22.0s`) 强制新建 TCP 连接后 100% 一次成功**：在 Mihomo 日志中，上述每一笔请求都在 `+21.8s ~ +22.5s` 准时出现一条新建的 `[TCP] magpie --> daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com:443` 记录；且在新连接上即使 TTFT 长达 `21s ~ 32s` 也能一次成功。

---

### 根因分析 (Root Cause)

1. **代理链路的 60 秒空闲回收 vs Go 默认 90 秒 `IdleConnTimeout` 形成“僵尸连接窗口”**：
   - 绝大多数 SS / IEPL 中转节点及 NAT 网关的会话空闲超时（Idle Timeout）为 **60 秒**。当两轮 Agent 请求间隔在 **55 ~ 89 秒** 时，远端代理节点已经静默回收了上游连接，但本地代理（`127.0.0.1:7890`）并不会主动向 Magpie 发送 TCP `FIN`。
   - 由于 `http.Transport` 默认 `IdleConnTimeout` 为 90 秒，且 Go `http2.ClientConn` 在无活跃流（0 active streams）期间不会主动发 PING 探活，Magpie 认为该连接依然可用并直接写入下一轮大上下文 `POST` 请求。
2. **`daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` 在 `high` 推理强度下首包静默期长**：
   - 当上下文较大（100k~400k tokens）且开启 `high` 推理时，Google 内部端点在完成隐式思考前不会下发任何字节。
   - 请求写入半死连接后无法收到回包，直到满 **20.0 秒** 触发 `HTTP2Config.SendPingTimeout` 发送 HTTP/2 `PING` 帧（或底层重传超时），中转端才返回 `EOF`，导致每次都白白挂起 21 秒后才建新连接重试。

---

### 建议修复方案 (Suggested Fix)

1. **缩短代理模式下上游连接池的 `IdleConnTimeout`（或在复用空闲超过 30~45 秒的 HTTP/2 连接前先行健康检查）**：
   - 在 `internal/netproxy` 中，当请求走代理（Proxy）或针对 `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` 等长耗时流式上游时，将 `IdleConnTimeout` 从默认的 `90s` 下调至 **`30s ~ 45s`**（低于代理节点常见的 60s 回收阈值），避免复用处于 60s~90s 僵尸窗口期的死连接。
2. **针对流式推理请求调整 `SendPingTimeout` 或连接预检机制**：
   - 对于空闲超过一定时间（如 `>20s`）的缓存 HTTP/2 连接，在发送非幂等的 `POST streamGenerateContent` 之前若无法立即确认连接活性，优先使用新连接或更早触发探测，避免在死连接上硬等满 20 秒 `SendPingTimeout`。

### 环境信息 (Environment)
- **OS**: macOS (arm64)
- **Magpie Version**: `v0.1.2729` (Go 1.26.8)
- **Agent**: DeepSeek Harness / Claude Desktop
- **Provider / Model**: `antigravity/gemini-4-argon` (`effort: high`)
- **Proxy**: Clash Party (Mihomo) `127.0.0.1:7890`

issue.title: Direct connection fails with net/http: TLS handshake timeout — Go default post-quantum key share (X25519MLKEM768) is dropped by some networks

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### Environment
- magpie-windows-amd64.exe (Go 1.26.8), Windows 11
- Provider: third-party OpenAI-compatible relay, `https://api.example.com/v1`, `baseAPI = responses`
- Provider proxy set to **Direct**; Settings -> Network proxy = **Off**

### Symptom
Testing any model on that provider returns:

```
gpt-6.1-terra 通过 Responses 协议没有响应: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
```

The same provider with a custom HTTP proxy (`http://127.0.0.1:7897`) works every time. `curl` from the same machine to the same URL also works every time.

### Root cause
Controlled experiment: same host, same moment, `openssl s_client`, varying only the key share group.

| `-groups` | Direct | Via HTTP proxy |
|---|---|---|
| `X25519` | OK | OK |
| `P-256` | OK | OK |
| `X25519MLKEM768` | **timeout (4/4)** | **OK (2/2)** |

Go 1.24+ enables `X25519MLKEM768` by default. It grows the ClientHello from ~300 bytes to over 1500 bytes, which forces IP fragmentation. On this network path the fragmented ClientHello is dropped, so the handshake never completes and Go reports `TLSHandshakeTimeout` after 10s.

### Request
1. A per-provider **TLS compatibility mode** that disables the post-quantum key share:

```go
&tls.Config{CurvePreferences: []tls.CurveID{tls.X25519, tls.CurveP256}}
```

2. Or, when a Direct provider fails with `TLSHandshakeTimeout`, retry once with classical-only curve preferences before surfacing the error.

### Workaround that works today
Starting magpie with `GODEBUG=tlsmlkem=0` in its environment restores direct connections. It is process-wide, hence the per-provider toggle request.

### Note
This is likely not specific to one relay: any Go 1.24+ HTTP client talking to a server that supports PQ hybrid key exchange can hit it on affected networks.
